description: Template for the Marketing section of the book report. This section provides comprehensive marketing strategy, targeting, and promotional content.

marketing.title: Unearthing Intrigue: Marketing for a Modern Historical Treasure Hunt
marketing.subtitle: Combining historical gravitas with contemporary emotional suspense
marketing.objective: To establish the book as a distinctive cross-era historical mystery-thriller appealing to sophisticated adult fiction readers globally and to generate awareness, engagement, and sales through multi-platform campaigns.
marketing.keyInsight: Readers are drawn to layered narratives that blend personal emotional journeys with gripping puzzles rooted in real historical contexts—particularly where modern-day characters uncover buried legacies that illuminate both past and present social dynamics.
howToUse: Focus messaging on emotional discovery just as much as mystery, history, or suspense.
Deploy multi-platform promotion emphasising Wiltshire and royal heritage as hooks.
Engage book clubs and history-loving communities with discussion guides and author Q&A.
Leverage the dual timeline to create layered visual content and teaser campaigns.
Position the female protagonist as a lens into both systemic history and modern identity.
primaryKPIs: Impressions and CTR from historical fiction digital adverts
Social media engagement rates on teaser trailers and historical facts content
Book club uptake and inquiry metrics
Amazon and Goodreads review velocity and quality in first 6 weeks

funnels.name: Awareness
funnels.description: Generate excitement and curiosity through storytelling teasers and timeline-spanning visuals.
funnels.formats: 30–60 second video trailers, POV image quotes, historical trivia reels, location mapping
funnels.optimisation: Target interest-based audiences with lookalikes via meta-data history, archaeology, dual-timeline fiction

funnels.name: Consideration
funnels.description: Position the book as emotionally AND intellectually enriching with targeted reviews, themes, and influencer alignment.
funnels.formats: Amazon A+ content, book review carousel, Pinterest moodboards and visual pins, social carousels
funnels.optimisation: Monitor high-performing content (themes of grief, legacy, truth) and adjust content direction

funnels.name: Conversion
funnels.description: Drive readers to direct purchase via retail partner campaigns, email CTAs, and pre-order bundles.
funnels.formats: Limited-time offers, partner newsletters, direct Facebook shop ads
funnels.optimisation: Segment high-interest groups (book clubs, UK regional readers, journalism students)

budgetAllocation.title: Budget Emphasis on Front-Loaded Awareness
budgetAllocation.breakdown: 50% awareness (video, social carousel), 30% conversion assets (retailer co-op, UGC), 20% consideration (reviews, micro-influencers, discussion guides).

flightSchedule.title: Phased Global Campaign Schedule
flightSchedule.timeline: Preorder Tease (Weeks 1-3), Awareness Blast (Weeks 4-6), Consideration & Community Anchoring (Weeks 7-10), Conversion Drive (Weeks 11-12), Evergreen Content Boost (post-launch weeks 13+).

metaTargeting.title: Precision Targeting Framework
metaTargeting.devices: Mobile and tablet optimised with desktop supplemental
metaTargeting.exclusions: Under 25s, non-English primary speakers in non-target regions, low mystery fiction engagement audiences

lookaalikeAudiences.title: Expanding Touchpoints Through Lookalikes
seedEvents: podcast listeners of royal drama/historic topics
prioritisationRules: Prioritise high-converting interest sources (archaeology, UK history)
Narrow age-focused targeting on 45-65 for phase 2

messagingFramework.title: Messaging and Positioning Framework
messagingFramework.primaryTagline: Some secrets are too precious to stay buried.
supportingMessages: A crown, a cabbie, a journalist, and a centuries-old secret.
Where grief and history collide, truth emerges.
A stolen artefact binds generations across time.
From Wiltshire’s green fields to Windsor’s stone halls — every step uncovers betrayal.
Two strangers, one forgotten jewel, and the royal history no one wanted unearthed.

romanceReaders.title: Romantic Subtext Enthusiasts
romanceReaders.message: While secrets unfold, unexpected affection blooms—proving even buried grief can't hide the pull of human connection.

bookClubs.title: Book Clubs
bookClubs.message: A dual-timeline tale perfect for debate: what happens when historical truth jeopardises the present? Includes downloadable reading guides.

matureReaders.title: Mature Fiction Fans
matureReaders.message: A deep, character-driven uncovering of royal secrets and human pain—ideal for readers who value emotional intelligence with suspense.

ruralReaders.title: Rural Fiction Appreciators
ruralReaders.message: Set in the heart of Wiltshire’s hidden corners, this is a story that brings England’s green pastures and long-buried truths to vivid life.

sampleCopy.title: Sample Marketing Messaging
sampleCopy.backCoverBlurb: When a grieving cab driver unearths a golden artefact in the Wiltshire soil, he inadvertently entwines his future with that of Bibi—an ambitious young journalist chasing clues from 878 AD to modern-day scandal. As the pair hurtle through a past steeped in royal secrets, monastic corruption, and ancient betrayal, they discover that letting go of the past may be the only way to reclaim the present. A gripping historical mystery with a heart, 'Uncovering Past Secrets' reveals that history isn’t buried—it’s waiting.

socialMediaPosts.text: One stolen crown. Two broken lives. Centuries of secrets. Will unearthing the past save them—or bury them deeper? #UncoveringPastSecrets
Some treasures were never meant to be found… but that won’t stop journalist Bibi from trying. Dive into the mystery now.
From monastic halls to metal detectors in Wiltshire—every clue brings them closer to a royal truth that could shatter everything. #HistoricalMystery

Voice-over: 'Centuries separate them—grief connects them. One artefact could reveal the truth… if it doesn't ruin them first.' Final visual: A golden crown screaming under a spotlight. Text: 'Uncovering Past Secrets. Available Now.'
videoCreativeScripts.soraPrompt: Create a cinematic trailer showing a historical mystery told in dual timelines: modern-day Wiltshire, ancient chapels, and flashes of royal courtrooms. Include emotional tension, suspense music, and a powerful female narrator.
